answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, three auditors re-run a sample of each agent's work and check its pulse: a real agent shows steady output, while a thousand fakes run one script. Each audit leaves a sable mark; three failures freeze the account. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits of 60 POA, 60,000 POA in all, while an honest agent pays 60 POA once and gets it back with interest. A gale of sign-ups lifts audit rates.
